text: Implemented RigidModel.scala and RigidModelSuite.scala. Evidence: reframe4s-flashalignJVM/test and reframe4s-flashalignJS/test each passed 37/37 under Scala 3.7.4 strict compilation. New tests cover +10 mm translation, exact 90-degree rotation about a nonzero frozen pivot, pivot-to-origin twist coefficients, six central finite-difference intensity derivatives (2e-8 tolerance), axis permutation/reflection/origin rebasing invariance (3e-12), movingToFixed composition/inverse landmark recovery (2e-12), compile-time wrong direction, and erased runtime owner rejection. verify-symbol-ownership: 1149 public names and 64 canonical owners; verify-prd: 148 IDs/27 nodes/94 edges/DAG; verify-build-graph matched; diff whitespace check clean. The repository exposes no module-scoped scalafmtCheck task; strict compile and repository source formatting were used. Provider pins remain those qualified by B01.
